data.comment:
# Comfy Vidu Q1- Text to Video

Generate high-quality 1080p videos from text prompts with adjustable movement amplitude and duration control using Vidu's advanced AI model. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_vidu_text_to_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: A snowboarder completes a difficult aerial spin in a half-pipe. The video is shot from a follow 视角，and the wide-angle lens creates a strong sense of immersion and visual impact. The snowboarder speeds up from the snow slope, performs a stretched-out flip and board grab in the blue sky with a graceful posture, and finally lands steadily in one go. The bright sunshine, the majestic snow-capped mountains in the background, together with the snowboarder's bright clothes and snowboard, form a magnificent picture combining strength and beauty, perfectly showing the speed, skills and free passion of snowboarding.
